scope: dracon-warden and dracon-security source/package controls only; no deployment, loaded-runtime, or fleet claim

gates.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated> cargo test -p dracon-warden -p dracon-security --locked -- --test-threads=2
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated> cargo clippy -p dracon-warden -p dracon-security --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
rustfmt --edition 2021 --check --config skip_children=true <modified Warden Rust files>; git -C dracon-warden diff --check

targetedRegressions.wardenTrackedRepairHardlinkRefusal: 1 passed; refuses before truncating a hardlink alias to .gitignore
targetedRegressions.securityMarkerMigrationAliases: 2 passed; refuses hardlink and symlink-root paths without changing metadata
targetedRegressions.securityBackupRestoreHardlinkRefusal: 1 passed; refuses restoring through a hardlink alias before truncation

nonGateRun.result: 0 tests matched (filtered out); immediately replaced by successful substring-filtered targeted runs and the complete package test run above

implementedBoundaries: Warden resmudge apply takes the per-worktree canonical writer fence before inspecting or opening tracked .gitignore/.gitattributes targets.
Generic library restore/migration refuses direct canonical metadata names; shared writers reject final symlinks and multiple-link inodes before truncation.
Tracked repair writes validate opened regular-file identity and single-link status before truncation.
remaining: No end-to-end concurrent resmudge --apply test with encrypted canonical metadata; existing CLI integration is dry-run only.
No post-integration full-workspace tests, release build, strict all-target Clippy, or cargo deny qualification.
No deployment or loaded-runtime verification; cooperative-writer coverage remains bounded to the recorded syscall receipt and does not qualify every tool interface.
